responsibility: Builds and stores the borrow checker’s canonical inventory of MIR borrows for a body. It records each borrow by its issuing location and `BorrowIndex`, tracks the borrowed and assigned places, regions, and kinds, identifies reservation and activation points for two-phase borrows, groups borrows by base local for fast conflict checks, and summarizes which locals may become invalid at function exit so later borrow analyses can ignore or kill loans correctly.
